value.rationale: The primary paper singles out a best-known binary [28,7,12] code and its dual. Counting all subcodes attaining each generalized Hamming weight is a natural higher-support incidence invariant, not a routine re-evaluation of the ordinary weight enumerator. It refines the hierarchy by quantifying the full extremal geometry in every dimension and has an equivalent affine-section interpretation of the source's 28-point defining set. The exact value M_3=64 in particular records a nontrivial three-dimensional extremal layer not visible from ordinary weights alone.
